主要内容: Crowell & Moring launched Crowell Health Solutions, a strategic consulting firm, to assist healthcare organizations and tech companies in transforming healthcare through improved patient care, health equity, and cost reduction. The firm focuses on digital health innovations and value-based care models. Led by Jodi Daniel, Troy Barsky, and Janet Walker—former government officials with healthcare experience—the firm offers services in strategic counseling, policy engagement, coalition building, and compliance. Daniel emphasized the shift toward digital health technologies and AI, while Barsky highlighted the firm’s role in driving policy changes and connecting industry players. Walker noted the growing number of companies entering healthcare with new technologies to improve care quality and accessibility. The firm aims to provide strategic guidance to navigate complex regulatory environments and support innovation in value-based care.
